title: Garou: Mark of the Wolves/Jae Hoon
text:
left
 Name: Kim Jae Hoon
 First appearance: Garou: Mark of the Wolves
 Other appearances: none

Kim Jae Hoon (キム・ジェイフン) is the youngest son of Tae Kwon Do master Kim Kaphwan. Like his father, Jae Hoon has a strong sense justice and is very committed to training. While he gets along with his older brother well enough, he often scolds him for being lazy and not taking his training seriously.

Story (in Garou: Mark of the Wolves)
right
Jae Hoon is a hard-working Tae Kwon Do practitioner, and the youngest son of Kim Kaphwan. He, along with his brother Kim Dong Hwan, entered the "King of Fighters Maximum Mayhem" tournament to track down the mysterious man who defeated their father. The Kim brothers overpowered Freeman, the mystery man, and he escaped. In Jae Hoon's ending, Jae Hoon has a brief crisis of self and his beliefs in justice. Dong Hwan snaps him out of it and the two travel home.
